source_refs.note: 3- Chromatids: a main subheading of 19.1.2 Chemical Composition and Organization of Chromosome, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 118-118.

blocks.text: The chromatin fibre folds upon itself to make a supercoil (300 nm thick). The supercoil further coils and condenses and takes the shape of chromatid (700 nm thick).
